Validation rules

Source: R/v2-validate.R
shad_rules.Rd

Rules for shad_validator(). Each is a function of a field value returning NULL when valid or an error message string. Empty optional fields skip non-required rules (matching shinyvalidate).

Usage

shad_rule_required(message = "Required.")

shad_rule_email(message = "Enter a valid email address.")

shad_rule_min_chars(n, message = NULL)

shad_rule_max_chars(n, message = NULL)

shad_rule_range(min = -Inf, max = Inf, message = NULL)

shad_rule_regex(pattern, message = "Invalid format.")

shad_rule_in(choices, message = NULL)

shad_rule_fn(fn)

Arguments

message

Custom error message (NULL uses a sensible default).

n

Character/threshold count.

min, max

Numeric bounds.

pattern

A regular expression.

choices

Allowed values.

fn

A custom function(value) returning NULL or a message.

Value

A rule function.

See also

Other shadshiny forms: shad_form_counter(), shad_form_message(), shad_form_summary(), shad_validator(), update_shad_form_field()

Examples

r <- shad_rule_required()
r("")      # error message
#> [1] "Required."
r("hello") # NULL
#> NULL
